t: You are looking at Hyme House, at 3 Fitzjohns Avenue in Hampstead. It was the London home of the society portrait painter Philip de László, an Anglo-Hungarian artist. He painted many of his portraits here, at sittings in the studio and in the gardens. His sitters in the 1920s and 1930s included royalty, celebrities, businesspeople and politicians. That makes this house a working studio as well as a home. De László died here in 1937.
